title: Child Development - Infant/Toddler Care Teacher
award: Certificate of Achievement requiring 16S/24Q to fewer than 30S/45Q units

program.section_heading: Child Development - Infant/Toddler Care Teacher (Certificate N0864)
outcomes: Be grounded in Child Development knowledge (theory) and use their understanding of young children and their needs to create environments that are healthy, respectful, supportive, and challenging for each child.

Understand that successful programs depend upon partnerships with children's families and communities. They use this understanding to create respectful, reciprocal relationships that support and empower families and to involve all families in their children's development and learning.

notes: Closed list prints 'CHLD72' (no space, units not stored); the catalog prints 'CHLD 72' at 1 unit. Treated as the same course, so catalog_addition is false.

Trailing digits after course names (e.g., 'Principles and Practices in Child Development Programs 1', 'Infant Toddler Practicum Field Work Experience 2') read as footnote markers (TB clearance; immunization documentation), not units.
Outcomes taken from the page's Outcomes tab, headed 'Program Learning Outcomes'; the tab is attached to this certificate's section. The page also links to separate SLOs not printed here.
Printed course units sum to 25, matching the stated Total Units 25.

Overview mentions 16 specified G.E. units and 2 adult supervision units for the Master Teacher permit; these are permit requirements, not part of the certificate's course list, and were not recorded as blocks.
